subject: Adult's Wallet
text: Collecting at least 10 Gold Skulltula tokens and visiting the house in Kakariko Village rewards the Adult's Wallet, which increases carrying capacity from 99 Rupees to 200 Rupees.

evidence.quote: You need to collect at least 10 Gold...Skulltula tokens and head for the house...in Kakariko Village to obtain this....Instead of 99 Rupees, the Adult's Wallet...allows you to carry around 200 Rupees...at a time, it increases your max limit.

subject: Big Bomb Bag
text: In Goron City, blasting the rolling Goron after obtaining the normal Bomb Bag upgrades carrying capacity from 20 to 30 bombs.

evidence.quote: In Goron City after you have the normal...Bomb Bag, blast the rolling Goron and...he will upgrade you to the big one....Increases your capacity for carrying...bombs from a mere 20 to a more impressive...30 bombs, your new maximum limit.

subject: Big Poe
text: There are ten Big Poes found all over Hyrule Field that only appear while riding Epona.

evidence.quote: All over Hyrule Field, there are ten...of them total to be found on Hyrule...Field and they only appear on Epona.

subject: Empty Bottle
text: Collecting ten Big Poes in bottles and bringing them to the guy in Hyrule Town rewards an Empty Bottle.

evidence.quote: Collect ten of these Big Poes in bottles...and bring them to the guy in Hyrule Town,...he'll give you an Empty Bottle for them.

subject: Big Quiver
text: Hitting all ten targets at the Shooting Gallery in Kakariko Village with the Fairy Bow awards the Big Quiver, increasing arrow capacity from 30 to 40.

evidence.quote: In Kakariko Village once you have the...Fairy Bow, head for the Shooting Gallery...in the middle of town and hit all ten....The Big Quiver is a special bag for...putting arrows in, this one increases...your maximum capacity from 30 to 40.

subject: Biggest Bomb Bag
text: Playing the Bombchu Bowling Alley minigame at Hyrule Market after Dodongo's Cavern awards the Biggest Bomb Bag, increasing bomb capacity from 30 to 40 bombs.

evidence.quote: Head back to Hyrule Market after the...Dodongo's Cavern and play the Bombchu...Bowling Alley minigame to win this....Increases your capacity for carrying...bombs from a mere 30 to a more impressive...40 bombs, your new maximum limit.

subject: Biggest Quiver
text: Earning 1500 points at the Gerudo's Fortress Shooting Range awards the Biggest Quiver, increasing arrow capacity from 40 arrows to 50 arrows.

evidence.quote: Play the Shooting Range game at the...Gerudo's Fortress, you'll get this as...your prize for earning 1500 points....The Biggest Quiver is an arrow bag which...increases your maximum arrow carrying...capacity from 40 arrows to 50 arrows.

subject: Biggoron's Sword
text: Bringing the World's Finest Eyedrops to Biggoron atop Death Mountain yields the Biggoron's Sword, which deals at least twice the damage of the Master Sword.

evidence.quote: Bring the World's Finest Eyedrops to...the Biggoron atop the Death Mountain and...he gives you this weapon in return....The Biggoron's Sword is the strongest...sword in the game, it does at least twice...the damage that the Master Sword does.

subject: Blue Rupee
text: A Blue Rupee is a generic pickup found in chests, enemy drops, and random locations that gives five Rupees.

evidence.quote: You can find this item almost anywhere...in the game, from chests to enemy drops...to randomly locations all over the place....This item is a generic type of item which...adds to your total accumulated Rupees,...this particular one gives five Rupees. .

subject: Dodongo's Cavern
text: Inside Dodongo's Cavern, the Bomb Bag is found inside of a large treasure chest on the second floor, allowing Link to place bombs from his own bag.

evidence.quote: Inside the Dodongo's Cavern, you will...find the Bomb Bag inside of a large...treasure chest on the second floor....Instead of having to grab Bombs from the...flowers, you can take them out of your...own bag and place them whenever you want.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: Bombchus can be won at the Bombchu Bowling Alley minigame in Hyrule Market after Dodongo's Cavern.

evidence.quote: After Dodongo's Cavern head back to...Hyrule Market and play the Bombchu...Bowling Alley minigame to win some.

subject: Bombchu
text: Bombchus run on a timer before exploding, and unlike regular bombs they move along the floor and climb walls.

evidence.quote: Similar to bombs they run on a timer and...they explode, however unlike bombs they...move along the floor and climb walls.

subject: Bombs
text: Bombs are generic pickups found almost anywhere or purchased in a shop to refill normal bomb supplies.

evidence.quote: All over the place, this generic pickup...can be found almost anywhere and it...can also be purchased in a shop....It will refill your supply of normal...bombs by different amounts depending...on how many you find or buy.

subject: Inside Jabu-Jabu's Belly
text: In Jabu-Jabu's belly, defeating four aquatic enemies in a room causes a chest containing the Boomerang to appear.

evidence.quote: In Jabu-Jabu's belly there is a room...with four aquatic enemies, defeat them...and the chest containing this appears.

subject: Boss Key
text: Boss Keys are found in special coloured chests in every dungeon as Adult Link to open locks leading into the boss' room.

evidence.quote: Boss Keys are found in numerous places,...there is one in every dungeon as Adult...Link, found in special coloured chests....This Boss Key will open up the larger...special locks found in dungeons that...always lead you into the boss' room.

subject: Broken Giant's Knife
text: In Goron City as Adult Link, a large Goron sells a Giant's Knife for 200 Rupees that becomes the Broken Giant's Knife after using it a couple of times.

evidence.quote: As Adult Link enter Goron City and find...the large Goron who has finished making...this and sells it for 200 Rupees....When you break the normal Giant's...Knife by using it a couple of times,...then of course this is what it becomes.

subject: Broken Goron's Sword
text: The carpenter at Gerudo Valley gives the Broken Goron's Sword in exchange for the Poacher's Saw as part of the sidequest to get the Biggoron Sword.

evidence.quote: This is given to you by the carpenter...at Gerudo Valley in exchange for you...giving him the Poacher's Saw you have....This item is part of the sidequest...to get the Biggoron Sword, for more...information see that section of the guide

subject: Bug
text: Bugs can be caught under rocks using an Empty Bottle, and dropping them into a small hole may cause a Gold Skulltula to pop out.

evidence.quote: These little creepy crawly creatures can...be found under various rocks and caught...if you use an Empty Bottle on them....Sometimes perhaps if you drop them...into a small hole, maybe a Gold...Skulltula might just pop out.

subject: Bullet Bag
text: Shooting all ten targets at the Shooting Gallery in Hyrule Market awards a Bullet Bag that upgrades Fairy Slingshot Deku Seed capacity from 30 seeds to 40 seeds.

evidence.quote: In the Hyrule Market on the opposite side...from the entrance is the Shooting Gallery...shoot all ten targets to acquire this....The Bullet Bag upgrades your Deku Seed...capacity for the Fairy Slingshot from...30 seeds to 40 seeds when you get it.
